How much does a kitchen renovation cost in Western Sydney? Most Western Sydney kitchen renovations land between $25,000 and $65,000 fully fitted. Budget refresh starts around $18,000 (cabinet doors, benchtop, splashback). Mid-range full reno is typically $35,000-$50,000. Premium with stone, brass and custom joinery can exceed $80,000. How long does a kitchen renovation take in Sydney? Allow 4-8 weeks from contract signing to handover. Site work itself is usually 2-3 weeks once cabinetry is on site. Lead time on cabinets, stone and appliances drives the front half. Do you handle strata approval for unit kitchens? Strata kitchens often need written approval before work starts. Ask your strata manager what documents they require, then confirm those requirements with the renovation provider before signing. Are you NSW-licensed builders? Kitchen renovation work in NSW can require appropriately licensed trades and builders. Check the licence details of the provider you choose before approving work. What warranty do you give? Warranty terms vary by provider, product and contract. Ask for workmanship, cabinetry, benchtop and appliance warranty terms in writing before work starts.
